subject: Review and develop the Kosika preview (kosika-preview.html)
body:
A standalone preview has been created at kosika-preview.html to let agents and humans quickly understand what Kosika is. Three Freebuff agents are ready to review and develop it:

- preview-reviewer (meredith/mint) — verify the preview matches reality, flag inaccuracies
- preview-dev (jonas/coral) — improve the preview, add missing real capabilities
- preview-designer (aisha/peach) — make it visually clean and on-brand

Can I spin these up through Freebuff to review the preview, verify it against the real CLI, and improve it together? The live workbench at http://127.0.0.1:8765 should also be checked.
